TK-LU01-LA03 | UNIT 1 LEARNING ACTIVITY

Safety-first response

Open each panel. The aim is to protect people, avoid isolated decision-making and activate the approved response without escalating the situation.

Put people first

Why this matters:

The response principle: safety before assets

A real or suspected tiger-kidnapping situation is a human-safety event. This activity provides awareness guidance only. If there is immediate danger, contact local emergency services and use your organisation’s designated security or crisis contact.

Summary: calm action, coordinated support

Do not negotiate alone, improvise an operational answer or spread the concern. Focus on immediate safety, involve trained responders through a trusted channel and record only factual information when safe to do so.

Practical takeaway: If you see a warning sign or receive a threat, pause. Put people first. Contact the approved support route; it is there to protect you.
